ITEM 1 | Pale golden-cream flatbread-like wedge with browned, blistered spots and darker char flecks along the edge, slightly matte surface, soft-looking, roughly triangular piece about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, lying on the white plate with a small amount of red sauce peeking from underneath | 45
ITEM 2 | Triangular wedge with a thick pale top layer and a visible bright orange-red sauce layer beneath, slightly glossy sauce, edges browned, about 8 cm long and 4 cm wide, overlapping the center of the plate beside item 1 | 40
ITEM 3 | Golden-tan triangular piece with uneven browning and darker brown speckles, matte surface, a few small dark spots, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, lying at the lower right of the plate partly overlapping item 2 | 40
ITEM 4 | Red-orange tomato-colored sauce visible as a thin smear between and beneath the wedges, slightly glossy, spread in a thin layer about 4 cm across, sitting on the plate surface under items 1 and 2 | 10
